  • 日本語名: 恥辱家系図
  • 英語名: Chijoku Kakeizu

あらすじ

Main character has to flee from his house and find a modest room nearby. However, feels jealous of a warm relations family that moved into his house, so he decides to break that family. However, he gets so exhausted from starving that he is found unconscious by that family members. Only women live in this house, and he takes this chance to spread his poison.

item.title: Seireiko ~Mireille no Namida~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Fukurou
  • 発売日: 2003-08-01
  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 精霊湖～ミレーユの泪～
  • 英語名: Seireiko Mireille no Namida

あらすじ

Main character majors in fantasy university at a university in France. His research brings him to a forest lake where he meets beautiful girl Mireille who visited him in his dreams. When he kissed the girl he had no idea he was kissing spirit of the lake. The fairies of the lake dragged him to the bottom of the lake to a new unexplored world.
